verdict: Revenue rose 6% to $9.45B on the ChampionX deal and a strong North America, but restructuring and pension charges held GAAP profit flat at $735M.

kpis.note: Cash from operations of $1.51B minus investment

segments.name: North America
segments.note: US and Canada drilling and production work, boosted by the ChampionX acquisition.

flow.otherDetail: Other income of -$65M is interest and other income of $68M minus interest expense of $133M. Equity of -$45M is the share of profit belonging to noncontrolling interests, leaving $735M attributable to SLB out of $780M total net income.

takeaways.title: Growth came from deals and North America
takeaways.text: Revenue rose to $9.45B. North America jumped 24% to $2.40B, helped by ChampionX, which added $956M of revenue in the quarter.

takeaways.title: One-time charges cut into profit
takeaways.text: GAAP EPS fell 2% to $0.49. Excluding charges and credits, EPS was $0.64, as restructuring and a pension settlement charge weighed on reported results.

takeaways.title: Cash generation stayed solid
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $828M in the quarter, and the board kept the quarterly dividend at $0.295 per share.

oneTimers: Restructuring and other charges of $187M in the quarter, including a $187M non-cash pension settlement charge.
Merger and integration costs of $55M, mainly for ChampionX. Net income excluding charges and credits was $962M versus $735M GAAP.
